findings.text: after_suite's parenthetical calls fe1bf820 "this node's head" while line 7 of the same manifest lists db4e9a58 as the head, and db4e9a58 landed after the suite ran, so at delivery the label names a revision the manifest's own commits line contradicts; the observation itself is sound because db4e9a58 changes only the archive evidence file and the owned paths were the same at both revisions, and the repair is to name the revision the suite measured rather than the head, with no re-run needed.

item_verdicts.diff: read all five commits against base 01eeb308caec57684d5bb79664dbd0749b2d1798 commit by commit; the change is one module-private helper plus its five-case gate, followed by three documentation commits, and reckon/crew/promotion.py and tests/test_gate_log_is_preserved.py are byte-identical between the node head db4e9a58 and the merged head 05c3fe77 this review's tree sits at (git diff --numstat over the five paths lists neither file), the merge's one-line archive plan-verifies replacement and the plan's version/impl scalars being server-owned bookkeeping rather than node content.

item_verdicts.manifest: read the delivered manifest in the run directory; status complete, the five commits listed, the tests line naming the focused gate and the cohort pair, negative_control_log a bare path, and the four added failure ids named by file and line as out of scope rather than triaged - but one claim is stale at delivery, after_suite's parenthetical calling fe1bf820 "this node's head" while the head the same manifest lists is db4e9a58 (finding 1).

justifications.durability: every one of the five cases reddens under a named control the node ran and recorded - :180, :207 and :240 under the declared no-copy mutation, :274 under the relocation control, :313 under the refusal control - and the two assertions round one called tautological now read the row back from the ledger and delete the cited original before asserting bytes, docked one for the two assertions that cannot fail (:204 is subsumed by :203's containment, and :300's containment is trivially true for a citation already inside the directory).
justifications.evidence: tests/test_gate_log_is_preserved.py is named with 5 passed, the cohort pair and all three control logs are on disk under test-logs/ and the run directory with their declarations on line 1, and the four added failure ids are attributed by file and line - docked one because the manifest's after_suite calls fe1bf820 this node's head while db4e9a58 is the head it lists (finding 1), a stale label over an otherwise sound measurement.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion.py:540-587 is a module-private helper with a rationale docstring in the file's own idiom, its constant sits beside its user as the file's other constants do (compare :390 and :3081), it adds no public surface and no CLI option, and neither the code, the constant, the docstring nor the tests carries a plan label, ticket reference, version number or project name.
